item.text:
The likely fix is in [SubscribeCalendarModal.tsx](/app/packages/components/containers/calendar/subscribeCalendarModal/SubscribeCalendarModal.tsx:17). It hardcodes `10000`, shows a counter and `maxLength`, and uses only emptiness and `isURL` to disable submission. Its warnings cover the two link cases but never URL length. Add `CALENDAR_URL: 10000` in [constants.ts](/app/packages/shared/lib/calendar/constants.ts:98), then use it for one disabled flag and one warning helper with the requested priority. Guard form submission with that flag as well as disabling the button.

The shared mock belongs in the [calendar Jest setup](/app/applications/calendar/jest.setup.js) and [components Jest setup](/app/packages/components/jest.setup.js). Two calendar specs assign `window.ResizeObserver` inline; a mail test helper and mail spec also reassign it, so the “no reassignment outside setup” requirement extends beyond those two suites. [useGetCalendarSetup.ts](/app/packages/components/containers/calendar/hooks/useGetCalendarSetup.ts:80) already has a default export; a test mock for it must provide a default export so the real hook does not run.

I found no existing modal test. Boundary behavior to cover includes exactly 10,000 versus 10,001 characters, trimmed input, warning priority when conditions overlap, and submission through the form. This was diagnosis only; project source and tests were not changed.
